look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: a hand-written ALTER script, an overflowing checklist, snapshot A and B generating migration SQL, a migrate status table, and the dbd end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.

scenes.desc: A hand-written ALTER script with a vermillion stop mark: stop writing these by hand.
scenes.name: Hook

scenes.desc: An overflowing checklist: the ALTER, the order, the defaults, the constraints.
scenes.name: Checklist overflowing

scenes.desc: Snapshot A and snapshot B generate the migration SQL from the difference.
scenes.name: Snapshot A to B to SQL

scenes.desc: dbd migrate --status: where each database stands, per environment.
scenes.name: Status table

scenes.desc: End card with the dbd mark: review the design, the migration follows.
scenes.name: dbd

title: Migrations you don’t write by hand
